description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Teysa triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding one mana of any color.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
